Best data source: MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire products (MODIS/006/MOD14A1 or MODIS/006/MYD14A1) or VIIRS (NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1). import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Pedrógão Grande, Portugal - create a polygon covering the municipality
# Approximate bounds: [-8.25, 39.85] to [-8.05, 39.95]
pedrogao_grande = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
    [-8.25, 39.85],
    [-8.05, 39.85],
    [-8.05, 39.95],
    [-8.25, 39.95],
    [-8.25, 39.85]
]])

start_date = '2017-06-16'
end_date = '2017-06-21'  # exclusive, so covers 16-20

# 2. Data Acquisition - Try VIIRS first (better resolution)
viirs_col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(pedrogao_grande)

# Check collection size
viirs_size = viirs_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"VIIRS Images: {viirs_size}")

if viirs_size == 0:
    # Try MODIS as fallback
    print("No VIIRS data, trying MODIS...")
    # Combine MODIS Terra and Aqua for better coverage
    modis_terra = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .filterBounds(pedrogao_grande)
    modis_aqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD14A1') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .filterBounds(pedrogao_grande)
    fire_col = modis_terra.merge(modis_aqua)
else:
    fire_col = viirs_col

# Check total collection size
total_size = fire_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"Total Fire Detection Images: {total_size}")

if total_size == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Count fire pixels
    # Define function to extract fire pixels (FireMask >= 7 for VIIRS, similar for MODIS)
    def extract_fire_pixels(img):
        # For VIIRS: FireMask values 7,8,9 = fire
        # For MODIS: FireMask values 7,8,9 = fire (same)
        fire_mask = img.select('FireMask')
        # Create binary fire layer: 1 for fire, 0 for non-fire
        fire_binary = fire_mask.gte(7).And(fire_mask.lte(9))
        return fire_binary.rename('fire')
    
    # Apply to collection and sum across all images
    fire_col_mapped = fire_col.map(extract_fire_pixels)
    fire_sum = fire_col_mapped.sum()
    
    # Count fire pixels
    fire_count = fire_sum.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=pedrogao_grande,
        scale=1000,  # Use 1km scale for MODIS/VIIRS
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('fire').getInfo()
    
    # Also count total valid pixels (non-cloud, non-water) to check if area was observed
    # Get one image to check observation
    first_img = ee.Image(fire_col.first())
    # Count pixels that are not cloud (value 3) and not unprocessed (0,1)
    valid_mask = first_img.select('FireMask').neq(3).And(first_img.select('FireMask').neq(0))
    valid_count = valid_mask.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=pedrogao_grande,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('FireMask').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Fire pixel count: {fire_count}")
    print(f"Valid observation pixels: {valid_count}")
    
    # 4. Validation & Final Answer
    if fire_count is None or valid_count is None:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif valid_count == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif fire_count > 0:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
